title: Megurine Luka — Take A New Angle〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I should head home...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luka, Len, thanks for listening. I'm gonna try my best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. I'm sure you'll do just fine, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, um... Please come back if anything does happen, okay? We'll be here to help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! See you later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
Mizuki seems to be feeling a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, especially compared to the face we saw earlier...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I was really surprised then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you were?
It's fairly normal for anyone to have something weighing on them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But Mizuki's such a nice person.
Trying so hard to come up with any way to help Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There is genuine kindness there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to help Mafuyu, but haven't been able to come up with any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that really all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My guess is that you're not just thinking about Mafuyu, but also yourself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But during our conversation, other realities came to light...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Still, now...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say that you're not capable of helping her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I believe there's something you can do specifically because you ran from everything until now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just look at things from a slightly different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We shall see how Mafuyu takes what Mizuki is going to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Since she may very well act on what she hears instead of just listening to it.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Len, is something wrong?
You always avoid making eye contact with me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? No, um... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You want to slip back into your shell when I look back, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've been wondering this for a while now... Are you afraid of me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What? No, uhh...
I'm not afraid of you, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're not afraid of being blunt or talking about serious topics. My heart jumps whenever I hear that sort of stuff...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, during your conversation just now, you weren't afraid to call Mizuki a coward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
I simply said what was on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because the unadulterated truth is what makes people pause or snap out of it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially when it's something they don't want to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That seems really mean not just to Mizuki, but the others as well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, is that how you see it?
Then, allow me to remedy your misunderstanding.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The way I see it, they're all being bound by forces that are keeping them from escaping these unfortunate circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Unfortunate circumstances...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Each of them is in a different situation. Some are in shackles, while others are surrounded by high walls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And one even seems to prefer being imprisoned...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In any case, doing nothing won't solve anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, they need to break free.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Does what I'm saying make a little more sense now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
But “break” still sounds kinda strong...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe what you're feeling is also valid, Len. Getting a person to rise up after being subjugated for so long is going to involve some amount of pain.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And if you can't break free of your shackles, you'll just have to tear your own arms off. And if push comes to shove...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-B-B-But that would be excruciatingly painful...! We can't let anyone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That was just an example.
I don't plan on causing them any pain needlessly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh... R-Right...
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(I think she's just teasing me a little...
B-But she still kinda scares me...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? What's going through your mind now...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! N-Nothing...!
